story.text: 이기대 해안산책로, 파도 소리를 배경으로 저 멀리 광안대교의 불빛이 반짝였다. 여행의 마지막 밤이었다.
story.reading: i-gi-dae hae-an-san-chaeng-no, pa-do so-ri-reul bae-gyeong-eu-ro jeo meol-li gwang-an-dae-gyo-ui bul-bit-i ban-jjag-yeot-da. yeo-haeng-ui ma-ji-mak bam-i-eot-da.
story.en: Along the Igidae coastal trail, the far-off lights of Gwangan Bridge sparkled against the sound of waves. It was the last night of the trip.

story.text: 용우는 평소보다 말이 없었다. 난간에 기대어 한참 불빛만 바라보다가, 문득 입을 열었다. '내일이면 돌아가는구나.'
story.reading: yong-u-neun pyeong-so-bo-da mal-i eop-seot-da. nan-gan-e gi-dae-eo han-cham bul-bit-man ba-ra-bo-da-ga, mun-deuk ib-eul yeol-eot-da. nae-il-i-myeon dol-a-ga-neun-gu-na.
story.en: Yongwoo was quieter than usual. Leaning on the railing, he stared at the lights for a long while before finally speaking. 'Tomorrow we go back.'

story.text: '이번 여행, 되게 좋았어요. 표도 같이 끊어주고, 몰래 사진도 찍고, 스트랩까지…' 웃으며 하나씩 꼽자 용우가 헛기침을 하며 시선을 피한다.
story.reading: i-beon yeo-haeng, doe-ge jo-ass-eo-yo. pyo-do gat-i kkeun-eo-ju-go, mol-lae sa-jin-do jjik-go, seu-teu-raeb-kka-ji. us-eu-myeo ha-na-ssik kkop-ja yong-u-ga heot-gi-chim-eul ha-myeo si-seon-eul pi-han-da.
story.en: 'This trip was really good. You booked the tickets with me, you secretly took photos, even the strap...' As I counted them off, smiling, Yongwoo cleared his throat and looked away.

story.text: '…처음엔, 그냥 걱정돼서 따라온 거였다. 진짜로.' 낮은 목소리로 시작한 그가 말을 잇지 못하고 한참을 멈췄다.
story.reading: cheo-eum-en, geu-nyang geok-jeong-dwae-seo tta-ra-on geo-yeot-da. jin-jja-ro. naj-eun mok-so-ri-ro si-jak-han geu-ga mal-eul it-ji mot-ha-go han-cham-eul meom-chwot-da.
story.en: '...At first, I really did just follow you because I was worried. Genuinely.' He started in a low voice, then fell silent for a long while, unable to continue.

story.text: '근데 표 같이 끊을 때도, 사진 찍을 때도, 스트랩 고를 때도… 동생 챙긴다는 말로 넘기기엔, 내가 너무 많이 신경 쓰고 있더라.' 스스로도 낯선 고백에 목소리 끝이 흔들렸다.
story.reading: geun-de pyo gat-i kkeun-eul ttae-do, sa-jin jjig-eul ttae-do, seu-teu-raep go-reul ttae-do, dong-saeng chaeng-gin-da-neun mal-lo neom-gi-gi-en, nae-ga neo-mu man-i sin-gyeong sseu-go it-deo-ra. seu-seu-ro-do nat-seon go-baeg-e mok-so-ri kkeut-i heun-deul-lyeot-da.
story.en: 'But when we booked the tickets together, when I took your photo, when I picked out that strap... calling it just 'looking out for my sibling' — I was caring way too much for that to explain it.' His voice wavered at the end, as if the confession itself felt unfamiliar even to him.

story.text: '동생이라는 말로는, 이제 설명이 안 된다.' 그가 처음으로 스스로 그 단어를 완전히 내려놓았다. 눈빛이 흔들림 없이 나를 향해 있었다.
story.reading: dong-saeng-i-ra-neun mal-lo-neun, i-je seol-myeong-i an doen-da. geu-ga cheo-eum-eu-ro seu-seu-ro geu dan-eo-reul wan-jeon-hi nae-ryeo-noh-at-da. nun-bich-i heun-deul-lim eop-si na-reul hyang-hae iss-eot-da.
story.en: 'The word 'sibling' — it doesn't explain this anymore.' For the first time, he set the word down completely, on his own. His eyes stayed fixed on me, steady and unwavering.

story.text: '나머지는… 내일 말할게. 오늘은 여기까지만.' 애써 목소리를 가다듬으며 화제를 돌렸다. '대화 몇 개만 더 듣고 들어가자. 나도 마음 좀 추스르고.'
story.reading: na-meo-ji-neun, nae-il mal-hal-ge. o-neul-eun yeo-gi-kka-ji-man. ae-sseo mok-so-ri-reul ga-da-deum-eu-myeo hwa-je-reul dol-lyeot-da. dae-hwa myeot gae-man deo deut-go deul-eo-ga-ja. na-do ma-eum jom chu-seu-reu-go.
story.en: 'The rest of it... I'll tell you tomorrow. That's as far as I can go today.' He forced his voice steady, changing the subject. 'Let's listen to a few more conversations before we head in. Let me collect myself, too.'

words.example_en: He leaned on the railing, gazing at the sea.

words.meaning: To count off, list one by one
words.example: 여행의 좋았던 점을 하나씩 꼽아 보았다.

words.example_en: I counted off, one by one, the things I loved about the trip.
He stopped, unable to continue speaking.
His voice wavered at a confession that felt unfamiliar even to him.

words.meaning: To set down, let go of
words.example_en: He finally set down the word 'sibling.'

turns.speaker: 손님
turns.text: 내일이면 돌아가네요. 이번 여행 진짜 좋았어요.
turns.reading: nae-il-i-myeon dol-a-ga-ne-yo. i-beon yeo-haeng jin-jja jo-ass-eo-yo.
turns.en: We're heading back tomorrow. This trip was really great.

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.reading: na-do. cheo-eum-en geu-nyang geok-jeong-dwae-seo tta-ra-on geo-yeot-neun-de.
turns.en: ...Me too. At first I only came along because I was worried.

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: …지금은, 모르겠다. 그 말로는 설명이 안 되는 것 같다.
turns.reading: ji-geum-eun, mo-reu-get-da. geu mal-lo-neun seol-myeong-i an doe-neun geot gat-da.
turns.en: ...Now, I don't know. I don't think that word explains it anymore.

dialogues.question: 용우가 '그 말로는 설명이 안 된다'고 한 것은 무엇을 가리키나요?
dialogues.question_en: What does Yongwoo mean when he says 'that word doesn't explain it anymore'?
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 손님을 향한 마음이 더 이상 '동생을 걱정하는 마음'이라는 말로는 설명되지 않는다는 것을 깨달았습니다.

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.text: 표 끊을 때도, 사진 찍을 때도, 스트랩 고를 때도… 그게 다 동생 챙기는 걸로는 안 되더라.
turns.reading: pyo kkeun-eul ttae-do, sa-jin jjig-eul ttae-do, seu-teu-raep go-reul ttae-do, geu-ge da dong-saeng chaeng-gi-neun geol-lo-neun an doe-deo-ra.
turns.en: Booking tickets, taking your photo, picking out the strap... none of that added up to just 'looking out for a sibling.'

turns.speaker: 권용우 기장
turns.reading: na-meo-ji-neun nae-il mal-hal-ge. o-neul-eun yeo-gi-kka-ji-man ha-ja.
turns.en: ...I'll tell you the rest tomorrow. Let's stop here for today.

dialogues.question: 용우가 마음을 다 말하지 않고 다음 날로 미룬 이유로 가장 알맞은 것은?
dialogues.question_en: What best explains why Yongwoo put off finishing his confession until the next day?
dialogues.correct_answer: 벅찬 감정을 추스르고 제대로 된 마음으로 전하고 싶어서
options: 벅찬 감정을 추스르고 제대로 된 마음으로 전하고 싶어서
dialogues.explanation: 용우는 벅차오르는 감정을 추스르고 제대로 마음을 전하고 싶어서 나머지 말을 다음 날로 미뤘습니다.
